excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a museum preparator, curly black hair, African ethnicity, goatee. Wears a purple tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, blue jeans and white sneakers.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_5 uses a micro-chisel and lightweight hammer to split away slabs of slate grey organic shale matrix, exposing massive, interlocking Tylosaurus paddle phalanges on his workshop table. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
